catalog: catalog-209.json; all 209 entries and document instructions read before product changes

entries.name: Dock
entries.sourceRead: complete TSX; source mechanisms reviewed separately from demo
entries.mechanism: Cosine-squared proximity field changes neighboring items; bounded spring integration sleeps at rest; focus follows the same field; click bounce returns to rest.
entries.adoption: Keep proximity/focus response and bounded click bounce in stable, separate hit boxes; phone uses whole fixed-width slots and no hover prerequisite.
entries.limits: Do not copy scale-to-fit below usable targets, delayed action dispatch, auto-hide menus or mount-only reduced preference.

entries.name: ElasticSlider
entries.sourceRead: complete TSX; source mechanisms reviewed separately from demo
entries.mechanism: Bounded authoritative value; duration/damping springs for activation/fill/stretch; sigmoid overpull, cross-axis compression, release recovery.
entries.adoption: Source study only this round; combine only after an actual demo is reviewed.
entries.limits: Pointer cancel currently commits, 34px hit area, internal state and wheel capture unsuitable without adaptation.

entries.name: CometDial
entries.sourceRead: complete TSX; source mechanisms reviewed separately from demo
entries.mechanism: Angular position with direction/velocity comet tail; dead center; tap spring and projected flick settling; keyboard updates.
entries.adoption: Source study only this round; could serve rotation/hue, never replace unrelated exposure controls.
entries.limits: No Escape/window-blur/lost-capture rollback; cancellation can commit; animated aria reading and no precise input; size cost.

entries.name: WakeSlider
entries.sourceRead: complete TSX; source mechanisms reviewed separately from demo
entries.mechanism: Head critically follows pointer; velocity is separately smoothed; velocity sets amplitude/reach; direction skews forward/trailing wake; bars settle flat after motion stops.
entries.adoption: Use actual velocity/direction/decay on existing PrecisionRange; keep bounded exact value and current one-transaction/cancel ownership.
entries.limits: Do not carry over missing cancellation rollback or couple engine value to visual spring; reduced mode stays flat.

entries.name: ScrubField
entries.sourceRead: complete TSX; source mechanisms reviewed separately from demo
entries.mechanism: Drag threshold distinguishes edit from scrub; Shift/Alt speed; bound feedback; press selects exact numeric input; Escape cancels.
entries.adoption: Use click-vs-drag numeric field plus fine/coarse modifier, with strict project numeric parser, IME, stale-draft checks and one commit.
entries.limits: No fake out-of-range number; do not copy permissive parseFloat, lost-capture commit or missing blur lifecycle.

entries.name: WarmTooltip
entries.sourceRead: complete TSX; source mechanisms reviewed separately from demo
entries.mechanism: Cold 400ms / warm 300ms group memory; shared portal travels between measured anchors; grace exit, keyboard focus, Escape and optional touch long press.
entries.adoption: Short optional shortcut/meaning; preserve existing aria-describedby; flip and clamp to viewport; Escape clears visible tooltip synchronously.
entries.limits: No required permission/error/status only in tooltip; do not steal long press on sliders/canvas. Parent demo Escape still showed immediate bubble: adaptation must fix and verify.

entries.name: RubberSegment
entries.sourceRead: complete TSX; source mechanisms reviewed separately from demo
entries.mechanism: Measured leading/trailing edges stretch in sequence then settle; drag dead zone, edge rubber, velocity-based flick; keyboard immediate selection.
entries.adoption: Controlled native-button segmented choices with edge spring behind fixed text; retain Enter/Space and disabled semantics; no drag capture on scrollable rails.
entries.limits: Original lacks native onClick handling, so do not copy pointer-only commit; no fixed widths or motion of text.

entries.name: SquishSwitch
entries.sourceRead: complete TSX; source mechanisms reviewed separately from demo
entries.mechanism: Thumb position spring and velocity-driven stretch/squash; pointer threshold, hover response and cancellation restoring prior state.
entries.adoption: New controlled boolean switch with stable 44px target; visual drag preview, single final callback; native click/keyboard preserved.
entries.limits: Do not copy repeated server/undo writes while crossing midpoint, aria-disabled-only or missing lost-capture/blur cleanup.

entries.name: SpecularButton
entries.sourceRead: complete TSX; source mechanisms reviewed separately from demo
entries.mechanism: Actual fragment shader uses pointer-lit rim and opposite glint; offscreen pauses; optional translucent body.
entries.limits: GPU context per button competes with photo rendering; luminance/glow distracts from color judgments; mounted reduced snapshot still reacts to pointer.

entries.name: OptionWheel
entries.sourceRead: complete TSX; source mechanisms reviewed separately from demo
entries.mechanism: Curved vertical scrolling options with easing, wheel capture, snap, optional audio ticks and step-dependent opacity/blur.
entries.adoption: Reject for tool/ratio choice: current direct options take fewer actions and keep choices visible.
entries.limits: Uncontrolled selection, no reduced preference, no Home/End or active descendant, pointer-cancel commits; captures panel scrolling.

entries.name: Cobp color palette
entries.sourceRead: Complete HTML/CSS and displayed license, captured by root official Edge
entries.runtimeDependencies: No JS; CSS sibling selectors and :has
entries.mechanism: 32x40 button; 40x40 color face; central hover 1.5, next neighbors 1.3 and 1.15; 500ms cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.1); hex label appears
entries.adoption: Reuse real current color values and selected state; keyboard focus triggers neighbor response; separate small visual face from 44px phone hit target. Existing clipboard helper alone may produce copied receipt.
entries.limits: No clipboard JavaScript exists. Focus pseudo-label only says Copy; aria-color is not an accessible name. Do not claim source implements copying.
